create_random_sharpness_transform: create a RandomSharpnessTransform to randomly apply sharpness with values between 0.1 and 1.9
create_random_posterize_transform: create a RandomPosterizeTransform to randomly posterize images with bit depths between 4 and 8
create_random_solarize_transform: create a RandomSolarizeTransform to randomly solarize images with thresholds between 0 and 256
create_autocontrast_transform: create an AutoContrastTransform to apply autocontrast enhancement to images
create_random_value_applier: create a RandomValueApplier to sample random values and apply a root transform to PIL images
